title: Small Volume Viral RNA Extraction Using MagMAX Viral RNA Isolation Kit
author: Erika Bujaki
materials: Select the MVRI_DUO_SV_300ul Protocol and press start.
Combine the components that are listed below:

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution 1
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution 1 by adding the indicated volume of 100% Isopropanol to the Wash Solution 1 Concentrate bottle.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting at least 5 times.
Mark the bottle to indicate alcohol was added.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution 2
steps.instruction: Prepare Wash Solution 2 by adding the indicated volume of 100% ethanol to the Wash Solution 2 Concentrate bottle.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by inverting at least 5 times.
Mark the bottle to indicate ethanol was added.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding Solution
steps.instruction: Combine the Lysis/Binding Solution components in the indicated order. Prepare enough for the day's samples and controls, adding an extra 10% for pipetting loss. Prepare on the day of use and keep at room temperature with a tightened lid.

substeps.instruction: Mix well by vortexing.
Add Carrier RNA to the Lysis/Binding Solution Concentrate according to the provided table and mix briefly.
Add 100% Isopropanol and mix well by vortexing.
Place the prepared mix on ice or in the fridge until needed (do not freeze).

steps.title: Prepare Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the bead mix on the day of use. It can be stored on ice for up to 4 hours; do not freeze.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the nucleic acid binding beads well to ensure full resuspension.

steps.title: Manual Extraction: Sample Lysate Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysate for each sample using 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind centrifuge tubes.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 600 μl of the Lysis/Binding Solution (supplemented with carrier RNA and 100% Isopropanol) into each tube.
Transfer 300 μl of the stool suspension supernatant to the tubes. Immerse pipette tips slightly to prevent aerosols and rinse the tip.
Mix gently by vortexing for 30s and spin briefly to collect content.

steps.title: Manual Extraction: Bead Capture and Washing
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to the beads and perform sequential washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 μl of prepared bead mix to each sample tube. Mix by pipetting using a new tip for each addition, rinsing the tip gently to ensure full volume transfer.
Mix thoroughly at gentle speed for 4 min (via shaker, rotator, or manual rotation/vortexing) until a visibly homogenous coloured mixture is achieved.
Centrifuge briefly, place on magnet for at least 2 minutes until beads form a pellet.
Carefully aspirate and discard supernatant. Centrifuge briefly if necessary to remove all lysis supernatant.

Wash with Wash Solution 1: Add 300 µl Wash Solution 1, vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge briefly, capture on magnet until clear, and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once more (2x total).

Wash with Wash Solution 2: Add 450 µl Wash Solution 2, vortex at moderate speed for 30s, centrifuge briefly, capture on magnet for 2 mins or until clear, and discard supernatant. Repeat this wash once more (2x total). Ensure all supernatant is removed after the second wash.

steps.title: Manual Extraction: Drying and Elution
steps.instruction: Recover the purified RNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge briefly and remove residual solution with a small volume fine-tipped pipette without disturbing the pellet.
Dry beads by leaving the tube open for 2 minutes (do not overdry to the point of cracking).
Add 50 µL Elution Buffer to each sample and shake/vortex vigorously for 4 min to resuspend the pellet.
Centrifuge briefly to collect content.
Open tubes and place on magnet. Collect the supernatant containing purified RNA into labelled containers.
Keep RNA on ice for immediate use or store frozen.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Duo Prime Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the 96 deep-well plate and instrument for the MVRI_DUO_SV_300ul protocol.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 600 μl of Lysis/Binding Solution (with carrier RNA and 100% Isopropanol) into row A of the 96 deep-well plate.
Transfer 300 μl of sample to row A. Mix by gently pipetting up and down. Immerse tips slightly to prevent aerosols and rinse the tip.
Add 20 μl of prepared bead mix to row A using a new tip for every addition, rinsing the tip gently.
Add 300 μl of Wash Solution 1 to rows B and C.
Add 450 μl of Wash Solution 2 to rows D and E.
Place a 12-tip comb in Row H.
Add 50 μl of Elution buffer/nuclease free water to the elution strip tube.
Ensure the device has the 12-tip magnet and heating block installed. If changing, use the 'Change Magnetic Head' protocol and run 'Check 12 tip' with a dummy plate.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Duo Prime Run

substeps.instruction: Load the sample plate onto the turntable, matching the A1 marking and ensuring it is flat.
Place the elution strip in the metal rack, matching the small round hole to the red conical protrusion and securing it with the fold-over lock.
Select the MVRI_DUO_SV_300ul Protocol and press start.
Close the front lid during the run.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Duo Prime Unloading
steps.instruction: Retrieve the purified RNA and clean the device.

substeps.instruction: When prompted, unload the elution strip and place it on ice.
Remove the sample plate, press the 'Check Mark', and discard the plate per lab procedure.
Wipe equipment clean and use UV light for disinfection.
Transfer eluted viral RNA to labelled containers; keep on ice or store frozen.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Flex Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare plates and instrument for the MVRI_Flex_SV_300ul protocol.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot 600 μl of Lysis/Binding solution (with carrier RNA and 100% Isopropanol) into a 96 deep-well 'Sample plate'.
Add 300 μl of samples to the Sample plate. Mix by gently pipetting up and down. Immerse tips slightly and rinse the tip.
Add 20 μl of prepared bead mix to the Sample plate using a new tip for every addition, rinsing the tip to prevent bead loss.
Add 300 μl of Wash Solution 1 to 96 deep-well plates marked FW1 and SW1.
Add 450 μl of Wash Solution 2 to 96 deep-well plates marked FW2 and SW2.
Add 50 μl of nuclease free water to wells of a 96-standard plate marked 'Elution'.
Place a 96 tip comb in a 96-standard plate.
Confirm the instrument is equipped with the 96 deep-well magnetic head and 96 deep-well heat block.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Flex Run

substeps.instruction: Select the MVRI_Flex_SV_300ul protocol, load the plates as directed, and start the protocol.
Close the front lid of the device.

steps.title: Automated Extraction: King Fisher Flex Unloading
steps.instruction: Retrieve the purified RNA and clean the device.

substeps.instruction: When prompted, unload the plate containing the RNA.
Transfer eluted viral RNA to labelled containers; keep on ice or store frozen.
Empty and wipe clean equipment; dispose of processing plates per standard laboratory processes.
